initial.name: bash
initial.description:
在 bash shell 里运行命令
* 调用本工具时，“command” 参数的内容不需要做 XML 转义。
* 网络访问取决于任务环境。可用时优先使用已配置的镜像/代理。
* 状态在多次命令调用和与用户的讨论之间保持持久。
* 要查看文件的某个行区间（例如第 10-25 行），可试 'sed -n 10,25p /path/to/the/file'。
* 请避免可能产生极大量输出的命令。
* 请把长期运行的命令放到后台执行，例如 'sleep 10 &'，或在后台启动服务。

command.description: The bash command to run. Relative path is preferred in the command.

initial.name: read_image
initial.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file and return the image itself. Large images are downscaled automatically; do not install image libraries or create thumbnails to inspect an image.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

initial.name: working_directory
initial.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.
